7.0: I am the person who notices when someone goes quiet. I make playlists for moods that do not have a name yet. I would rather listen than talk, except with two people, and then I never stop.

8.0: Loyal, stubborn, funny. I agree with two of them. I am still deciding about stubborn.

9.0: Drawing hands. Everyone says hands are the hardest part and somehow they are the only thing I get right.

10.0: Answer every message right away. Nobody ever asked me to. I just decided it somewhere.

11.0: Chapter Fifteen: In Which She Stops Saying Sorry To Doors.

12.0: What do you want to be? I say architect. I have never actually checked if I mean it.

13.0: That being liked by everyone is the goal. I think I only need four people and a dog.
